text.p: Canada 3000 has appointed Air Support as its Belgium general sales agent, the Canadian airline said in a statement.
Canada 3000 operates a weekly B757-200 service on Amsterdam Schiphol-Toronto, via Halifax. Air Support is already the airline's gsa in the Netherlands.
Eurohandling will be the carrier's handling company in Brussels and the trucking will be carried out by Rutges between Brussels and Schiphol.

In the Netherlands, Toronto based Canada 3000 Airlines Ltd has appointed Aeroground Services as its handling company at Schiphol. Previously the carrier's ground handling was carried out by Dutch national carrier, KLM and Avia Presto. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
